info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Feedback Submission API
info.description: The Customer Feedback Submission API allows users to submit reviews related to banking case root cause analysis. This endpoint enables the collection of qualitative insights from customers, helping organizations identify areas for improvement in their services. Typical consumers include customer service departments, product managers, and quality assurance teams looking to enhance user experience. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure they are addressing the most pressing issues highlighted by their clients.

post.summary: Create a review for the root cause analysis of a servicing case.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a review for the root cause analysis related to a specific servicing case identified by its unique reference. The review provides insights and feedback to enhance the case analysis process.
